opportunities.title: The Open Fund for Music Creators
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based songwriters, composers, artists, bands, producers and performers who write their own music, at any career stage and in any genre.
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding music creators of all genres and backgrounds at different stages of their career with grants of up to £5,000 for the creation, performance and promotion of outstanding new music.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Music Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK based artists/bands writing their own music.
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of £5k-£15k for UK based artists/bands to break through to the next level of their careers. Activities eligible for support include recording, touring and marketing.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Liverpool
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Artists and bands writing their own music based in Liverpool City Region, and future industry professionals based in Liverpool City Region.
opportunities.summary: Targeted scheme supporting outstanding artists and bands outside London who face additional barriers in reaching a crucial career tipping point based on their location, with financial support of up to £5k.

opportunities.title: PPL Momentum Accelerator Tees Valley
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Artists and bands writing their own music based in Tees Valley, and future industry professionals based in Tees Valley.
opportunities.summary: Targeted scheme supporting outstanding artists and bands outside London who face additional barriers in reaching a crucial career tipping point based on their location, with financial support of up to £5k.

opportunities.title: Women Make Music

next_open_date.raw: TBC (one bumper deadline in the second half of 2026)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Women, trans and non binary songwriters and composers of all genres and backgrounds at different stages of their career, including artists, bands and performers writing their own music.
opportunities.summary: Supports the development of outstanding women, trans and non binary songwriters and composers of all genres and backgrounds. A single bumper deadline is planned in the second half of 2026 while the programme is being developed.

opportunities.title: International Showcase Fund (ISF)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based artists, bands, songwriters and producers who have been formally invited to perform or create new music at international industry-facing showcasing festivals, songwriting camps or conferences.
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of up to £5,500 for international export opportunities for UK-based music creators invited to international industry-facing events. Rolling deadlines (the SXSW 2026 deadlines have closed).

opportunities.title: Composers' Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Composers with a strong track record who are already making a significant cultural contribution in the UK and have potential for greater impact in the UK and overseas.
opportunities.summary: Gives composers with a strong track record direct access to funding at pivotal stages in their career. Supports up to 15 composers per year for activities such as recordings, promotion and performance of existing works, international co-commissions, residencies and sabbaticals.

opportunities.title: The Hitmaker Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Songwriters and producers working in popular music genres (UK-based).
opportunities.summary: Offers grants of £5,000 - £10,000 for songwriters and producers working in popular music genres to further develop their careers and writing/production.

opportunities.title: Early Career Promoter Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Independent (emerging/early career) promoters based in England.
opportunities.summary: Supports independent promoters across England with grant funding and capacity building support to bolster local, regional and national grassroots music ecosystems. Covers booking/programming/promotion of gigs, tours and performances, associated costs, and capacity building.
